overview.description: The GraniteShares 2x Long NTAP Daily ETF (NTAL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of NetApp, Inc. (NASDAQ: NTAP) stock. NTAL was launched on Jul 14, 2026 and is issued by GraniteShares.

data.title: GraniteShares Launches NTAL, TDCL and BTDL, 2x Long ETFs on NetApp, Teradata and Bitdeer
data.text: New single-stock ETFs give investors amplified leveraged daily participation tied to NetApp, Inc. (NASDAQ: NTAP), Teradata Corporation (NYSE: TDC) and Bitdeer Technologies Group (NASDAQ: BTDR).
